summary: Editas Medicine filed an 8-K on May 14, 2026, reporting new preclinical data for EDIT-401, a potential treatment for hyperlipidemia. The filing under Items 7.01 and 8.01 is a routine disclosure of scientific progress at the ASGCT annual meeting, not a special situation. No M&A, activist campaign, restructuring, or other corporate event is disclosed. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 is furnished, not filed, for SEC purposes.
